title: Renalase Identified by Machine Learning Methods As A Novel Independent Predictor Of Mortality In Hospitalized Patients With COVID-19
summary: Among 437 hospitalized patients with COVID-19, XGBoost ranked low serum renalase among predictors of 180-day mortality. This single-cohort analysis had no external validation and does not establish renalase as a causal factor; it had also been discussed in earlier literature.
ai_technology: XGBoost ranked clinical and laboratory variables, including renalase, for 180-day mortality prediction.
